title: Collect every page of a paginated API
prompt: The address of a server is in docs-url.txt. Its /api/items answers with JSON: {"page": n, "items": [{"id", "name", "score"}], "next": the address of the next page, or null on the last page}. Collect the items of every page and write items.json: a JSON list of all of them, highest score first, equal scores by id (lowest first), each item as the server gave it.
